listing.aiSummary: Provides a centralized mod registry and desktop manager for installing, updating, and tracking mods.

description:
Hey commanders,

I've been working on something I think the modding community has needed for a while — a proper centralized mod registry for Starsector, similar to what CurseForge does for Minecraft.

Starsector Directorate (name subject to change, if fractal admins want me to)

A web platform at <link removed -Alex> (I'll get a proper URL if there's any actual interest) where mod authors can host their mods permanently, and players can browse, search, and discover mods, with proper screenshots, descriptions, version history, dependency tracking, and reviews.

A desktop app (Windows, Linux coming later) that lets you install, update, and manage mods without touching files manually.

Why does this exist?
We've all been there. You find a mod you want, click the link in the index, and get a dead Google Drive URL. Or you're trying to figure out which of your fifteen mods needs updating, and you're manually checking the main index or fifteen forum threads just to grab the new version from a sketchy mega link. Or you've got two computers and your modpack lives entirely in your head.
Directorate fixes all of that.

Features
Web platform:

Permanent file hosting : every mod uploaded stays up, no dead links, no sketchy mega or photon links.
Direct download links in case people don't want to use the app.
Full mod pages with screenshots, markdown descriptions, changelogs
Version history with Starsector compatibility ranges per version
Dependency and conflict tracking between mods
Community reviews and ratings
Modpack profiles with shareable codes (e.g. DIR-4K9PZ) — share your exact mod list with anyone, public or private
Author profiles and DM system
Search and filter by category, tag, game version

Desktop app:

One-click install and update from the web platform
"Install in Directorate" buttons on mod pages open the app automatically
Dependency resolution : installs required mods automatically
Conflict detection before installing
Enable/disable mods, with optional game version override option.
JVM memory configurator (no more editing vmparams by hand)
Modpack profiles : save named loadouts and switch between them
Launch Starsector directly from the app

Current state
The web platform is functional and open — mod authors can create accounts and start uploading right now.
I've seeded it with a handful of mods I use just to test and get things started; if you're an original author and want to claim your mod listing, just register and send me a DM on the site and I'll transfer authorship. If you instead want your mod removed, just send me a DM here on these forums and I'll delete the listing.

The desktop app is in active development, very close to an initial release, and will be available shortly. Windows version first, with Linux coming after.

For mod authors
Hosting your mod on Directorate doesn't mean you have to stop hosting it anywhere else; think of it as a permanent mirror with a nicer interface. You get download stats, version history, and players can install directly without hunting for your forum thread, or direct download without the app.
The upload process is straightforward: create an account, create a mod listing, upload your zip. The site will automatically read your mod_info.json for the internal ID. Screenshots, descriptions (Markdown supported), dependency declarations, and changelogs are all supported.

Links
Website: <link removed -Alex> (due to change if enough interest, but this link will also work forever with a 308 redirect)
Discord: <link removed -Alex>
Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests welcome! Either here, on Discord, or via DM on the site itself.
- AllieL
